sentences.en: The threatening floods made it necessary to evacuate the town.
sentences.zh: 洪水威胁着这座城镇，不得不撤离。

sentences.en: E-eh? I somehow seem to feel a very threatening aura...
sentences.zh: 喂？我感觉周围好像有一种很强的威胁感……

sentences.en: She shouted and threatened a policeman by brandishing a knife.
sentences.zh: 她挥舞着刀子对着警察喊叫并进行恐吓。
